question.subtext: If you’re unable to log in, it may be due to an incorrect password, expired session, or account lock.

bullet-points: Double-check your username, email, or phone number.
Make sure Caps Lock isn’t on when typing your password.
If you’ve forgotten your password, select “Forgot Password” to reset it.

question.subtext: You can reset your password anytime.

bullet-points: Go to the Login screen/Profile – Security Settings and tap “Forgot Password”.
Follow the instructions sent to you.

question.subtext: You can reset your password or PIN anytime.

bullet-points: Go to the Profile – Security Settings and tap “Change your PIN”.

question.header: KYC Verification delay (Why is my account verification still pending?)
question.subtext: Verification ensures your account complies with financial regulations. Sometimes, checks may take longer if documents are unclear or require manual review.

bullet-points: Confirm that you’ve uploaded all required documents.
Ensure your ID details are correct.
If verification takes longer than 48 hours, please contact support.
